claim: README: Cost Saver = 10-30% savings from dedup, cache, squeeze
verdict: The 10-30% figure is ACHIEVABLE ONLY in the dedup best case (same file inlined multiple times): 63.5% here. On realistic single-pass Nexus prompts the squeeze reclaims 0% (mostly whitespace). The response cache saves 100% but ONLY on exact read-only repeats (a hit-rate, not a per-turn saving). RECOMMENDATION: the flat '10-30%' claim is not supported for a typical turn; either qualify it as 'up to ~X% when context contains duplicated file blocks, plus cache hits on exact repeats' or drop it.
